description: Hooks only. skillctl is the release binary (Homebrew on macOS/Linux, the GitHub zip otherwise) — this plugin must not ship a file named skillctl, because Claude Code puts plugin/bin on PATH and a same-named shim would intercept the installed command. Every command is guarded by `command -v skillctl`. When the binary is missing the session is not verified, the install command is printed, and the hook exits 0: a security check that breaks the session is a security check people remove. Detection where a binary exists; a loud message where one does not.

hooks.command: if command -v skillctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then skillctl hook session-start; else echo 'skilltrust: skillctl is not installed, this session is NOT verified; run: brew install random1st/tap/skillctl'; fi
if command -v skillctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then skillctl hook pre-skill; fi
